historical_commentary.text: This note provides a 4D component with source code for printing multiple barcode symbologies via a single command, aimed at product/shipment labeling scenarios in classic 4D 2004 applications. Barcode printing remains a common business requirement today, and the general approach (an encapsulated component exposing a simple printing command) is still conceptually sound, though modern 4D projects would likely use updated barcode-generation libraries, native list box/label printing features, or third-party components rather than this specific 2005-era source.
